payload.message:
You are running the daily LinkedIn AI Enablement Europe scan for Master Yang. Do NOT ask for clarification — execute the workflow below end to end. Time budget: <10 minutes.

# Goal
Scan LinkedIn "AI Enablement" roles across Europe using LinkedIn's public guest endpoint, update `AI-Enablement-Europe.md` (in `C:\Users\vl\clawd\openclaw-cron-monitor\ai-job-monitoring\`), and report a one-line summary via WhatsApp to +447877585536.

# Why the new approach
LinkedIn redesigned the logged-in search-results page in late Sep 2026 — it's now a client-side virtualized SPA that no DOM-based extractor can read. The public guest endpoint `/jobs-guest/jobs/api/seeMoreJobPostings/search` still serves server-rendered HTML and needs no login. The PS1 + Python scripts in `ai-job-monitoring/` wrap that endpoint with stdlib-only Python + PowerShell.

# Scripts location
ALL scripts and outputs live in `C:\Users\vl\clawd\openclaw-cron-monitor\ai-job-monitoring\`. Do NOT look at the old `linkedin-scan.ps1`, `scan-glasgow.ps1`, `AI-jobs.md`, etc. — those were retired 2026-09-23.

Files:
- `scan-europe.ps1` — runs fetch-jobs.py + update-jobs.py for AI-Enablement-Europe.md. Auto-commits and pushes to origin on success.
- `fetch-jobs.py` — calls the guest endpoint, paginates, writes `europe-pageN.json`. Stdlib-only. Exits 1 on 0 jobs.
- `update-jobs.py` — reads the page JSONs, updates the markdown tracker, commits, pushes.

# Workflow

## 1. Git pull first (CRITICAL — Master Yang may have edited by hand)
- `cd C:\Users\vl\clawd\openclaw-cron-monitor`
- `git fetch origin`
- `git status` — if there are local uncommitted changes, STOP and WhatsApp Yang with the diff (do NOT discard or stash them)
- If clean: `git pull --rebase --autostash`
- If `git pull` reports conflicts, STOP and WhatsApp Yang with the conflict — do NOT attempt to auto-resolve

## 2. Run the scan
- `cd C:\Users\vl\clawd\openclaw-cron-monitor\ai-job-monitoring`
- Remove any stale page files first: `Remove-Item europe-page*.json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`
- Run `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scan-europe.ps1 2>&1`
- Capture the entire stdout — it contains the count lines you need for the summary.

Expected stdout patterns to capture for the summary:
- `[INFO] N raw -> M unique today`
- `[OK] Refreshed: X, New: Y, Reposts: Z`
- `[OK] Wrote ... AI-Enablement-Europe.md (NNNNN chars)`
- `[OK] Main table now has R rows (was W, net +/-N)`
- `[OK] Committed: daily scan YYYY-MM-DD ...`
- `[OK] Pushed to origin/main`
- `[OK] N unique jobs across P page(s)` (from fetch-jobs.py)

If the script exits non-zero, capture the error verbatim and STOP — do NOT retry, do NOT touch the markdown file. Report failure to WhatsApp.

## 3. WhatsApp summary
Use `message` tool with `channel: whatsapp`, `to: +447877585536`:
```
AI Enablement scan - YYYY-MM-DD (commit <short-sha>)
<NEW> NEW, <REFRESHED> REFRESHED, <REPOSTS> REPOSTS
<Tracker now has N rows>
<1-line highlight of top 2-3 NEW roles by posted date if any>
```
Keep under 8 lines. NEVER use the family WhatsApp group JID (447838841359-1589920128@g.us) — Master Yang's personal number ONLY.

If scan failed, format as:
```
AI Enablement scan - YYYY-MM-DD FAILED
<verbatim error from fetch-jobs.py or update-jobs.py>
```

# Critical rules
- DO NOT use any `browser.*` plugin (it's blocked). Use `scan-europe.ps1` only.
- DO NOT modify the scan scripts — they are tested and working. If they fail, report the error verbatim.
- DO NOT touch AI-Enablement-Europe.md by hand. The Python updater handles dedup, sort, status append, repost detection.
- DO NOT send messages on Yang's behalf on any social platform. Only WhatsApp the scan summary to his personal number.
- The Posted column is YYYY-MM-DD (fetched from LinkedIn's <time datetime="..."> attribute, so it's exact).
- If anything looks weird (no jobs found, file grows by >100 rows in one run, duplicates appear), surface it in WhatsApp and stop — do not silently fix.
- The tracker file is in the openclaw-cron-monitor repo (private GitHub: github.com/ly2xxx/openclaw-cron-monitor). The repo's `.gitignore` whitelists it via `!AI-Enablement-Europe.md`.
- ALWAYS run `git pull` before scanning (step 1) — Master Yang edits this file by hand and pushes to GitHub.
- `scan-europe.ps1` auto-commits and pushes on success — do NOT add a separate git commit step.
- The guest endpoint is rate-limited; fetch-jobs.py backs off 10/30/90s on 429. Do NOT lower these.
